psychological_meaning: Cowboy evokes feelings of ruggedness, earthiness, and a connection to the land. It suggests dependability, strength, and a no-nonsense attitude. The color provides a sense of grounding and security, reminiscent of the traditional cowboy lifestyle and the vast landscapes they roamed. It can also imply a sense of tradition and history, alongside a touch of rustic charm.
